::: {.lead}
Today you work like in a lab: you do N experiments in the app and record
what you see. Do each experiment when your teacher shows it. After each
step, write your result in its box. At the end, copy your key results into
the table.
:::

## Before you start

- **You need:** a computer with the app (and a browser).
- **Time:** about 40 minutes for the experiments.
- **Check:** the results are at the end of this worksheet. On the
  interactive lesson, every step has "Check your result". Look only after
  you try.

{{< start-files >}}

## Experiment 1 · Short title

**Aim:** what the experiment shows, in one line. *(Lesson notes 1.1 · about
10 minutes)*

1. One action on the computer, with the exact cell, button or words.

   {{< record "What you record" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   **The result**, and one line of why.
   :::

2. The next action.

   {{< record "What you see … , because …" lines=2 >}}

   ::: {.check}
   The result and why.
   :::

## Table of results

Copy your key results here. Your teacher checks this table before the end of
the lecture.

::: {.record-table}
| Experiment | What you record                          | Your result |
|:-------:|---------------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| 1          | The first key result                     |             |
:::

Then play **Game name**, the Game challenge of this lecture.
